bottle.madeWith: Visual style: Deep sapphire shadow floor, crisp ivory white petals and translucent cobalt glass accented by cool silver mirror reflections. Soft, diffused blue light from camera-left. Shot on a 50mm prime lens with shallow depth of field. 0.0s–5.0s: Off-axis low-angle medium-close shot of the heart-shaped blue YAGI perfume bottle resting among scattered white flower petals in front of an oval mirror. The camera executes a slow, steady dolly-in toward the bottle, drawing focus onto the heart-shaped glass facets and YAGI label. Audio: quiet room ambience, no music.
